messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH severity — node gpu-rt-07 kernel panic detected; kubelet reported NotReady. Auto-page to eng-oncall.

mike_oncall: acked — I'm on it. Pulling logs and serial console now.

sara: oncall here, looking at serial console. Seeing repeat `kernel BUG` and `GPU reset failed` lines. NVMe errors interleaved. starting postmortem checklist.

lee_sre: I ran `kubectl get nodes gpu-rt-07 -o wide` — NodeStatus: NotReady, conditions: KernelPanicReported. Kubelet disconnected.

mike_oncall: Quick impact check: Cloud LB shows increased 503s from us-west-2 for ~5m. Autoscaler backed off some routes; fallback routing engaged but some short failures during failover.

tara_pm: Any customers impacted? support pinged yet?

sara: No inbound tickets in Zendesk yet. Metrics: model-generation endpoints saw a 1.3% error spike and p95 latency +120ms during failover window. Likely transient for long-running token streams.

lee_sre: Starting cordon + drain to force pods off the host.

lee_sre: running:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-rt-07
kubectl drain gpu-rt-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

mike_oncall: I'll add a temporary LB rule to route traffic away from the node's hostpool while we drain. Patching nginx config now.

sara: ipmi remote power cycle in progress via iLO, but logs show kernel panic from NVMe driver, likely hardware. I'll open RMA if it fails to come back.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Duplicate alert suppressed; escalation to infra-oncall after 6m with no status update.

mike_oncall: duplicate — I acked earlier, dpkg race caused duplicate. Noted.

lee_sre: Drain completed, pods rescheduled to healthy pool. Some long-lived KV cache sessions had to restart — we saw a couple of client reconnects.

sara: Quick rollback plan not needed; failover succeeded. Marking node unschedulable and tagging host for RMA. RMA ticket: RMA-8247 created.

tara_pm: Good. I'll draft a short internal blurb: "Transient 503s for a subset of us-west-2 requests for ~7 minutes while traffic failed over from a GPU host that experienced kernel panic; no customer-facing incidents reported so far. Monitoring continues." Shareables?

mike_oncall: sharing metrics link in #monitoring: <https://dashboards.redwood/team/latency?range=1h>

lee_sre: Adding notes to the oncall handoff: ongoing monitoring for 30 minutes, escalate if >0.5% error sustained. Suggested next steps: run hardware diag, replace NVMe on the host, validate kernel/driver revisions in the image.

sara: Handing off to infra-oncall @lee_sre in 20m. I'll stay available for context. Creating short incident doc in /incidents (stub) and linking.

incident-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-gpu-07 (auto). Summary posted to incident tracker.

mike_oncall: TL;DR: node gpu-rt-07 experienced kernel panic -> kubelet NotReady -> short client errors during failover; node cordoned, drained, RMA opened. Monitoring.

tara_pm: Thanks — I'll notify support to prep a status if any customers escalate. :thumbsup:

lee_sre: monitoring looks stable, p95 back to baseline. keeping the node out of rotation until RMA complete.

sara: closing this thread; continuing on RMA and writeup. ping me for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
